description: This Kotlin source file defines the MatchDetailsFragment class, which is a UI component in an Android TV application that displays detailed information about a sports match, including scores, logos, and highlights. It manages UI elements, external image loading, and user interactions.

classes.name: MatchDetailsFragment
classes.description: A fragment displaying detailed match information with options to view highlights. It handles data extraction from arguments, UI setup, image loading, and user interactions.

classes.name: DetailsDescriptionPresenter
classes.description: An inner class that extends AbstractDetailsDescriptionPresenter to customize the display of the match title and details.

classes.name: DetailsInfo
classes.description: A data class holding the textual match information along with logos URLs.

classes.name: DetailsInfoPresenter
classes.description: An inner class responsible for rendering DetailsInfo objects, including loading logos via the Coil image loading library.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the fragment, extracts match data from arguments, sets up UI components and adapters, and configures click actions for highlights.
